explanation: Habitat restoration via restoration ecology seeks scientific methods to return degraded ecosystems to their original state prior to disturbance. The discipline is guided by three core principles: 1) Initiate restoration as early as possible before the remaining habitat fragments are permanently lost. 2) Once the natural history of the ecosystem is fully understood, apply biological techniques to mimic natural ecological processes. 3) The ultimate overarching goal of these restoration projects is sustainable development.

questions.q: Which of the following is one of the three principles of restoration ecology?
opts: Begin restoration as soon as possible before remaining fragments are lost.
Wait until the ecosystem is completely destroyed before starting.
Rely solely on chemical herbicides to control invasive species.
Construct roads through the center of remaining fragments.
questions.exp: The notes state the first principle of restoration ecology: 'Begin as soon as possible before remaining fragments are lost.'

questions.q: What is the ultimate goal of restoration ecology according to the notes?
questions.exp: The notes state: 'Goal is sustainable development.'
